limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Owned lab accs (openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-accs), created for this seat from 4ca41822b685a2a1e58a38b4f25e421cf735c54e with lab.mjs (app 127.0.0.1:43357, mail 48457, subnets 10.243.57.0/24 and 10.244.57.0/24), Helix seed light profile, random seed 7, seeded 2026-09-28T07:21:50.673Z. Every organization-wide change (identity providers, allowed domains, sign-in methods, required two-factor, logo, email relay) was made on this lab only and put back; the lab was destroyed afterwards. The shared work lab was not used. The lab runs with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off, but the lockouts and email budgets are database counters and were observed.

Identity providers were a local OpenID Connect fixture (oauth2-mock-server 9.2.0, DOC-032/admin-org/oidc-fixture.mjs) with two issuers, http://oidc:8080 and http://oidc:8082, beside the lab (overlay-oidc.json). No vendor identity provider was used; the fixture asserts the fictional identity the script selects.

Single sign-on is not configured yet is reachable only through the legacy unsaved-policy fallback (the author's note). It was produced by fault injection on the owned lab: org_settings.auth_mode set to oidc with no saved policy and no provider, then set back to built_in.

Required two-factor was exercised with the Administrator's first sign-in through single sign-on and the Legal Team Member's through a password; each later method (password, sign-in link, single sign-on) asked for a code.

Product behavior recorded, not a guide error: removing the last identity provider while single sign-on is the only Legal method leaves no Administrator sign-in link (the defect the author and the admin-org seat recorded). The enrollment page also shows Confirm your password to start enrollment. without a Password field for an account that has no password; the guide's Enter Password if the page asks for it still holds.
The seeded organization has no saved logo on the staff page; the saved-logo branch was observed on the Portal sign-in page (portal-sign-in evidence), which uses the same public branding.

The five-minute sign-in link lifetime was read from the lab database and a used link was refused; the five-minute wait itself was observed for the Portal (portal-sign-in evidence). The one-hour password setup token lifetime was read from the lab database.
An Administrator landing on unfinished organization setup was not exercised, because the lab onboarding is complete.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 4ca41822 to ad345da5 (bridge): I read the whole app diff. The hunks that reach this guide are the nodemailer patch (every invitation, password-setup and sign-in link email) and the sharp patch (the saved logo on the sign-in page is stored at save time; sharp only checks it and makes the email logo). The access replay on bacc, built from ad345da5, passed all 65 staff-sign-in steps, with links read from Mailpit, two-factor, SSO with the OIDC fixture and the no-relay case. The smoke signed in Administrator and Legal Team Member. No statement changed.
